why: Each shard is one machine of e2e.yml flows job: what e2e/flow-history.mjs makes of e2e/flow-history.json (each part weighed by its 90th-percentile time over the measured runs; the launch and the keyboard probes on shard 1; each flow to the lightest shard, heaviest first; minutes = weight and a quarter). Read by e2e/shards.mjs and run-flows.sh; shards.test.ts and flowHistory.test.ts hold it.

firstRuns.push_tap_critique: New on 2026-11-10 (WORKLIST P4.22, a critique's push opens the log critiqued): weighed by the estimate for a flow with no runs (UNMEASURED_SECONDS) until its first runs are added (flow-history.mjs --add <run id>); then it leaves this list.
